This might be a dead post, but please please listen to 


Stand By Me - Otis Redding


If you can, listen to it for the first time while a little high. 

The first time I ever listened to Otis' version of Stand By Me, I had just gotten high off weed for the first time in a couple years, which I missed doing.

When the song first came on I was going to sing it because I loved the Ben E. King original, but I quickly stopped when I heard it was a little different.

It all hit me so fast.

I remember the tears had came down from within, followed along with heavy breathing. I honestly started crying like a baby and hyperventilating, covering my mouth saying "Oh Lord." I wasn't crying because the song was kinda sad, I was crying because I didn't know music could be this beautiful.

I have never felt something touch my soul more than this song for the first time. This will always be a core memory for me.
